pairs.subject: dynamic-secret-lifecycle
pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/e2e/dataset_delete_gate.rs:1 These eight end-to-end suites test dataset reads, the delete gate, doctor reports, engine conformance, VCR attempts, target exclusion, search degraded mode and dynamic WASM app listing; none of them mints, leases, renews or revokes a credential. A word-boundary search for issuer, renewal, max_ttl and lease_ttl across crates/server/src/e2e/ found zero hits. Within the eight files, revoke, credential, secret and ttl also had zero hits; the only substring match for lease was 'release' in a fetch_bytes test.

techniques.evidence: crates/server/src/e2e/dataset_reads.rs:1 This suite tests dataset read semantics. It provisions no remote credential, so there is no ordering of a lease write against a remote create to check.
crates/server/src/e2e/engine_conformance.rs:1 This suite tests fetch-engine conformance. No remote credential with its own expiry is created here.
crates/server/src/e2e/store_reports.rs:1 This suite tests the doctor report. There is no revocation callback anywhere in the context's files.
crates/server/src/e2e/vcr_attempts.rs:1 This suite tests which attempt the VCR cassette records. No lease TTL is computed from requests and defaults.
crates/server/src/e2e/target_exclusion.rs:1 This suite tests in-flight exclusion by target. No remote credential mutation needs a write-ahead record for rollback.
crates/server/src/e2e/dynamic_apps.rs:1 Here 'dynamic' means discovered WASM apps, not dynamic secrets. No issued artifact needs a lease decision.
